title: We use a lot of these
text:
We use a lot of these. We have been using this little timer for about three years now.
To be clear, we've used MANY of this STYLE of time over the last few years.

These are from the Dollar Store, and do what they are supposed to do for about a year.
The displays, even when brand new are not very easy to read, and you have to tip them
back and forth until you get just the right angle to actually view it. (Even then, I sometimes
cross my fingers that I read it right!)

They are easy to set. Because of the difficulty I have in reading them, I just count the minutes
while pushing the minute button!

If you are doing several batches, like when you bake cookies or muffins, you have to push
the Min and Sec buttons at the same time. Just push the start button to get it going.

The timer makes a beeping sound when it goes off. The beep gets weaker with time, so within a
couple months of regular use, you'll have to really listen for it carefully.
The magnets are useful - they have a magnet on the back, so we stick them to the vent hood
over the oven.

I'd like to find a reliable wind-up time, but haven't found a decent one yet that got good reviews.
So until then, we'll keep buying these 3 or 4 at a time from the local dollar store, and enjoy
them while they last. They come in three colors - black, blue or red.
